verdict.rationale: Letta keeps agent memory as Markdown files in a Git-backed memory repository, and its local and self-hosted modes keep all agent state (messages, memory, provider connections) on your own machine, so some data is already in open formats you control. However, no export command, export format, or migration path for leaving Letta Cloud is documented. Missing for 10: a documented export of all data (messages, agents, memory) from Letta Cloud, defined open export formats for conversation history, account deletion or offboarding documentation, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Each entry becomes a Markdown file in the agent’s memory repository
all agent state, including messages, memory, and provider connections, stays on-device, and no Letta account is required.
This default local mode stores agent state on your machine and does not require a Letta login.
